Interface InternetAccessService

All Known Implementing Classes:
InternetAccessServiceJson
public interface InternetAccessService
An Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v2 service, as returned by the create (POST /internetAccess/v2/services), get-details (GET /internetAccess/v2/services/{serviceId}), update (PATCH /internetAccess/v2/services/{serviceId}) and search (POST /internetAccess/v2/services/search) operations.

This is a read-only response view; the nested IP blocks and routing configuration are supplied at creation time through the builder.

The create response (ServiceCreateResponse) is a subset of the full read model returned by get/update/search (ServiceReadModel); fields not present in the create response (for example billing, locations, billingStartDate) are null on a freshly created service.
